title: Reconcile certificate addressing with upstream Yggdrasil
description: Review finding from project-LICHEN-worker6-viku.1: new certificate profile correctly requires upstream Yggdrasil AddrForKey, but earlier normative §8.5/§8.7 text in spec/06-security.md still describes the rejected SHA-512 native address profile. Reconcile the conflicting security-spec prose and conformance references.
close_reason: Reconciled spec/06-security.md §8.5/§8.7 with the upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision: routable /128 now normatively equals upstream AddrForKey (bit-invert key, addr[0]=0x02, addr[1]=leading-1 count, drop leading 1s + first 0 bit, bit-pack next 112 bits with zero-padded tail), /64s equal SubnetForKey in 0300::/8, SHA-512 native profile marked rejected/MUST NOT be used, IID re-scoped to link-local/human-address/key-identifier use only, conformance oracle repointed to the pinned upstream_addr_for_key vector (verified byte-exact against yggdrasil-go@422836ee). 3 review passes delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness, security, edge-cases; edge pass needed one retry after a 300s timeout). In-scope findings fixed; follow-ups filed: 9hnr (03/04/11/draft prose), q6ko (fixture quarantine + metadata + count-path vector), tpbj (§8.11 unwrapped protected header), zeaj (prefix_len byte alignment); comments on nqz6.3.3 (route-hash IID staleness), b7z9.28 (§8.7 vs §8.7.4 rotation format conflict), 4bju (ipv6_addr.h false doc claim).
